svg.title: Cheapest per call is not cheapest per task
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Cheapest per call is not cheapest per task” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn descending cost waterfall: a $0.190 baseline run falls through prompt caching minus $0.047, routing triage and verify to Haiku minus $0.015, evidence digests minus $0.024 and a semantic cache minus $0.028, then rises by $0.008 for verify-and-retry, ending at $0.084 a run - a 61 percent cut, with $0.253 and $0.098 per successful task boxed at either end. Beside it a scatter of cost per run against end-to-end success marks all-Haiku at $0.058 and 54 percent as $0.107 per success and therefore worse, the chosen configuration at $0.084 and 86 percent ringed in green as $0.098 per success, and the baseline at $0.190 and 75 percent, with a dashed Pareto frontier through the non-dominated points.
svg.text: Cheapest per call is not cheapest per task
